evidence: cobc -x compiler invocation in comments with GnuCOBOL flags (-fbinary-size, -fnotrunc, -fbinary-byteorder)
GOBACK used as main program terminator
END-READ, END-IF, END-RETURN inline terminators (COBOL-85 style)
SORT verb with INPUT PROCEDURE / OUTPUT PROCEDURE

purpose.summary: A batch COBOL sort program that reads sequential input records, sorts them on an ascending character key field, and writes summarised/aggregated output records by summing numeric fields within each key group. It validates required environment variables (dd_infile, dd_outfile, dd_sortwork) before processing.

notable_features: SORT verb with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE
COMP-1 (single-precision float) and COMP-2 (double-precision float) fields
REDEFINES clauses on sort record fields
ACCEPT ... FROM ENVIRONMENT for environment variable validation
Inline debug display statements commented out with 'test00**' prefix
Multiple sign representations: LEADING, TRAILING SEPARATE, LEADING SEPARATE
verdict.notes: The file references a COPY statement for 'wktotsum01' copybook (not shown) which defines Tot-* fields used throughout. Debug lines are conditionally commented with 'test00**' prefix rather than a standard debug mechanism. The program is authored by Sauro Menna (2016) under LGPL 3.0. The 'test00**' prefix lines are treated as comments by the fixed-format COBOL compiler since they start in column 7 with non-standard indicator characters.
